text: 周五公布的数据显示，继上月零增长之后，加拿大8月经济陷入停滞。零售、制造业和建筑业的增长，在很大程度上被批发贸易和公共管理部门活动的下滑所抵消。分析师此前预计，加拿大8月GDP将增长0.2%，高于7月的零增长。加拿大统计局的初步估算显示，9月GDP可能萎缩0.1%，使第三季度按年率计算的实际行业产出增速降至1.3%。制造业、采矿和采石业以及石油和天然气开采业活动下降，是经济表现疲软的主要原因。这一增速将显著低于加拿大央行最新预测。该行此前预计，第三季度经济按年率计算将增长2%。加拿大统计局表示，8月服务业产出下降，但商品生产部门活动增加，在很大程度上抵消
text_en: Data released on Friday showed that Canada's economy stalled in August after zero growth the previous month. Growth in retail, manufacturing and construction was largely offset by declines in wholesale trade and public administration activities. Analysts had expected Canada's August GDP to grow 0.2%, up from zero growth in July. Preliminary estimates from Statistics Canada showed that GDP may have contracted 0.1% in September, bringing annualized real industry output growth in the third quarter down to 1.3%. Declines in manufacturing, mining and quarrying, and oil and gas extraction activities were the main reasons for the weak economic performance. This growth rate would be significantly lower than the Bank of Canada's latest forecast. The central bank had previously expected the economy to grow 2% annualized in the third quarter.
